authorization: 2026-10-16 user requested cumulative versus FIFO/random/similar context maintenance across new-attack budgets 10 through 400
purpose: Extend the context-policy comparison to the existing nested label-budget sweep with final-model evaluation
reference: Existing XGB cumulative retraining on identical released IDs
sampling: Reuse exact EXP77/78/80 stage plans; initial IDs unchanged and new-class subsets nested across budgets

deletion.fifo: Oldest acquisition order, with original within-stage ordering preserved; a proxy for age, not measured obsolescence
deletion.random: Seeded permutation of current buffer using 43 + stage_index * 1009
deletion.similar: Delete existing rows nearest to newly supplied labeled training rows; minimum Euclidean distance after standardization fitted only on current old buffer
deletion.common: Delete as many old rows as newly supplied rows, retain at least one example of each old class, append every incoming row, never retrieve previously evicted rows

model: Existing pretrained TabPFN v3, 4 estimators, fit_with_cache, CPU cache, no context subsampling
evaluation: Final model on the complete fixed test; identical label-independent seed-43 mixed query order, batch 8192, predictions stored in original row order
baseline_reuse: Reuse cumulative fit states and update costs; reuse the fully mixed reevaluation at budget 100; fully reevaluate other saved cumulative PFN models in the same mixed order. XGB saved row-wise predictions are reused and audited.
cost: Sum of later-stage context selection + model construction + fit, excluding initial preparation, all inference, checkpoint writing and audit checks. Historical cumulative costs and new buffer costs are explicitly identified.
